entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pankaj Kumar Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Pankaj Kumar Shukla, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anant Pratap
Singh, learned A.G.A. appearing on behalf of the State

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing
Case Crime No. 15 of 2019, under Sections 406, 420 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Wazirganj,
District Gonda.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 17.01.2019 alleging that the applicant had taken Rs. 1 lakh through account transfer and Rs. 20,000/- in cash in the year 2017.
The amount was transferred to the bank account of applicant's sister on 28.06.2017 from the account of the informant's elder brother.
The F.I.R alleges that the applicant kept on deferring repayment of the money and ultimately on 18.05.2018, he threatened the informant to entangle him in some false case.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

The applicant was involved in another case bearing Case Crime No. 414 of 2017 under Section 304B, 498A I.P.C and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition act, Police Station Wazirganj, District Gonda, in which the Investigation Officer has submitted a final report on 22.12.2017.
5.
The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R alleges transfer of Rs. 1 lakh from the bank account of the informant's brother to the bank account of the applicant's sister on 28.06.2017, besides payment of some cash amount to the applicant; that the informant has prayed for refund of his money through the F.I.R, which relief is of civil nature and can only be claimed through a civil suit seeking decree of recovery of money and no civil proceedings have been initiated by the informant and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
7. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicants is allowed.

In default of any of the conditions mentioned above or it is found that applicant has obtained this order concealing any material facts, the Investigating Officer shall be at liberty to file appropriate application for vacation of this order.

(Subhash Vidyarthi, J.) Order Date :- 18.10.2023 Preeti.
